Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wC-100, and reviewed_by stays null. No hardware was attached or run, and the sim backend (gym.make('trunk-v0'), which needs SOFA v23.06 with SofaPython3 and SoftRobots, README.md:12-20) was not run; the upstream clone was never imported, installed or modified (git status clean at f5ad4e44a0dc522d8018c184245b7aa630292118). The fake is this package's pure Python kinematic stand-in for TrunkEnv: it rebuilds the scene's cable geometry (TrunkScene.py:72-95), the action-to-cable mapping (TrunkToolbox.py:331-378), the 66-value state (TrunkToolbox.py:204-235) and the reward/done rule (TrunkToolbox.py:77-82 and :238-257), but it replaces SOFA's TetrahedronFEM deformation with a placeholder lateral bend and draws the goal with Python's random.Random instead of gym's np_random, so its trajectories and seed choices can differ from the clone; the fidelity gaps state this. The full 66-value observation is carried, not reduced. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is stored for the next reset and makes no native call), four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index, and seed in reset and seed), and four G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for step, close, action_space and observation_space, which TrunkEnv serves through its __getattr__ delegation to the wrapped AbstractEnv (TrunkEnv.py:65 and :82-85) and its AST surface cannot list; no G4 warning was reported. License recon: the clone has no LICENSE file at its root and neither README.md nor setup.py states a license, so the card's NOASSERTION and unknown class were copied unchanged into driver.lock.json; this is not a LICENSE_BLOCKED claim, but publish review remains required. Only catalogue cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
